Check-in

Tap CHECK-IN as players arrive, or NO SHOW if someone can't make it. Anyone you don't mark is assumed to be coming. Rounds that haven't started update themselves to match who's here. Once a round has a score, a running timer, a swap or a skip, it's locked and won't change.

Now Playing

Course 11 · 10 round-robin rounds, 10-min games + 2-min changeover), then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals. The timer is separate from the scores: games may finish early or use the full 10 minutes. Race to 11, win by 2, or highest score at time. No ties (sudden-death rally).
